query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM published_paths
                    WHERE cache_id = $1
                ) AS "paths!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM go_entries e
                    JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                    WHERE c.id = $1
                        AND e.generation = c.go_generation
                        AND e.expires_at > NOW()
                ) AS "go!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM sccache_entries e
                    JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                    WHERE c.id = $1
                        AND e.generation = c.sccache_generation
                        AND e.expires_at > NOW()
                ) AS "sccache!"
